references.text: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as the Lord had commanded.
Every firstborn must be redeemed, and the redemption price of five shekels of silver is to be given to the priests.
All firstborn males among the Israelites are to be redeemed.
The redemption money from the Israelites was to be used for the service in the tabernacle.
Setting the value of the redemption price in shekels based on the sanctuary weight.
